summary: Comprehensive testing of Device Smart Features (Iteration 168). All 17 backend API tests passed. Frontend testing confirmed DevicesSmartBar with Fleet Health and Bulk AI Diagnose buttons, 7 inline action buttons per device row in ticket detail (Remote, Terminal, Files, Metrics, Reboot, Diagnose, Snapshot), Live Metrics drawer with SVG sparkline and synthetic fallback, AI Diagnose dialog posting to tickets, and row-level Sparkles AI Diagnose buttons (135 found).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Device Smart Features fully functional. Backend endpoints: /api/devices/{id}/ai-diagnose, /api/devices/{id}/live-metrics, /api/devices/{id}/screenshot-to-ticket, /api/devices/fleet-health, /api/devices/fleet-insights, /api/devices/bulk-diagnose all working. Frontend: DevicesSmartBar renders on /devices page with Fleet Health and Bulk AI Diagnose buttons. Ticket detail shows 7 inline icon buttons per linked device. Live Metrics drawer shows 3 metric cards + SVG sparkline with synthetic fallback. AI features return real Claude responses.

backend_endpoints.ai_diagnose_with_ticket_id: Posts comment to ticket, returns posted_to_ticket=true
backend_endpoints.live_metrics: Returns current, series, minutes, online. Synthetic fallback with 20 points
backend_endpoints.screenshot_to_ticket: Returns success, image_url (null if TRMM not configured), comment_id, pending
backend_endpoints.bulk_diagnose: Processes up to 25 devices in parallel, returns count and results array

frontend_devices_page.bulk_diagnose_button: data-testid='bulk-diagnose-btn' - shows count of selected devices
frontend_devices_page.fleet_health_dialog: Shows score, band badge, 9 count tiles, AI Summary, Top 5 risky
frontend_devices_page.bulk_diagnose_dialog: Shows loading state then results with severity badges per device

mocked_apis.screenshot_to_ticket: TRMM screenshot is best-effort - returns pending=true when TRMM not configured. Comment posting still works.
